snippet.title: Tank Core // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3430070/Tank_Core/

"Tank Core" is a 2D top-down shooter game infused with Roguelike elements. Players will collect various random tank components in levels, including turrets, chassis, shells, modules, and cores, to assemble unique tanks that will protect base and defeat all enemies encountered.

Developed by 
Light Shield Studio
